title: Hedge fund recruits memory champion Nelson Dellis to remote view the stock market
place_text: United States (contacted via a memory Facebook group)

tellings.quote: To see if I if I'd be willing to be trained in remote viewing in order to remote view the stock market for them.

plain: A memory champion named Nelson Dellis was approached around 2022 or 2023 by a hedge fund, through a Facebook group for memory enthusiasts, and asked whether he would train in remote viewing, the claimed skill of perceiving distant or hidden information with the mind alone. The goal, as Dellis put it, was "to remote view the stock market for them." Chris Ramsay, a guest on the show, relays this as what Dellis told him, a sign, if true, that money people take such abilities seriously.
